name: Strengthening Species Conservation in Ontario (SSCO) Grant
summary: Grants for land trusts in Ontario to acquire and protect habitat for species at risk and to carry out conservation action on it. The 2026-27 round is part of a four-year fund.

steps: Securement or Conservation Action application submission

eligibility.rule: Be a non-profit, registered Canadian charity in good standing under the Income Tax Act
Be an OLTA member or associate in good standing at application and throughout the project
Have principal objectives of natural heritage protection and conservation
Not be a Conservation Authority; its foundation may apply
Project activities target one or more COSSARO-listed species
Project is prioritized through systematic conservation planning consistent with 2019 Standards and Practices
Property contains species-at-risk habitat, connects such properties, or can be restored to such habitat
For securement, obtain an appraisal within one year before closing from an AIC-Ontario-designated appraiser

documents: UTM/GIS files or property boundary coordinates (securement projects)
Conservation plan and relevant pages (securement projects)
Stewardship endowment fund policy/process evidence (securement projects)
Appraisal summary, or reasoned valuation if securement has yet to close and an appraisal is unavailable
Workplan outlining activities and draft timelines (conservation action projects)
Purchase, donation, easement or intent agreement for a securement project that has yet to close

status.quote: APPLICATIONS ARE OPEN. The Strengthening Species Conservation in Ontario (SSCO) Grant aims to increase the quantity and quality of privately protected habitat for species at risk in Ontario.

applicant_types.quote: Launched in 2026, Strengthening Species Conservation in Ontario supports land trusts in protecting species at risk through two streams: actions to restore and manage protected habitat for species at risk, and funding to conserve habitat.

geography.quote: increase the quantity and quality of privately protected habitat for species at risk in Ontario

access.quote: Completed applications and all documentation are to be submitted electronically via Foundant Technologies grant application portal

window.quote: This funding cycle represents the 2026-27 funding round of a four-year fund.

co_finance_required.quote: Have matching contributions at a rate of $1.00 non-provincial investment for every dollar of provincial funds.

effort.quote: Completed applications and all documentation are to be submitted electronically via the Foundant Technologies grant application portal by 11:59 pm on Sunday, December 13, 2026.
Your application will be evaluated by a Review Committee of

eligibility.quote: A non-profit, registered Canadian charity in good standing under the Income Tax Act (Canada);
A member or associate of the Ontario Land Trust Alliance in good standing of OLTA at the time of application and throughout the duration of the funded project;
Have the principal objectives of natural heritage protection and conservation.
Conservation Authorities are not eligible applicants, but their foundations may be - please contact OLTA.
Activities receiving funding through SSCO must target one or more species identified on the COSSARO list.
Have been identified as priorities through systematic conservation planning consistent with the Canadian Land Trust Standards and Practices (2019);

a. Contain habitat for species at risk b. Provide functional connectivity between properties that contain species at risk habitat; or c. Have the capacity to be converted or restored to species at risk habitat through eligible grant activities
Have a recent (no more than one year prior to closing) appraisal completed by an appraiser designated by the Ontario Association of the Appraisal Institute of Canada

co_finance.quote: For every $1 of Program funds awarded, a minimum of $1.00 in matching funds from sources other than Ontario Government must be contributed to the project. Matching funds may include both cash and in-kind contributions.

after_award.quote: For reimbursement grants, OLTA will provide payment after approval of the final report, with required documentation.

documents.quote: 1) UTM coordinates/GIS files of the property vertices and UTM zones; or other spatial files (shp, kmz). If you do not have spatial files, please send a table of coordinates of the property boundaries. 2) Location and property maps 3) Conservation Plan - How is the area identified as a priority through conservation planning? Identify the plan and include the relevant pages of the plan.
4) Completed Project Budget (as a spreadsheet, not a pdf). 5) Evidence of an established stewardship endowment fund policy/process.

8) A copy of the appraisal summary: -If a full or draft appraisal is not available at time of application submission, then an assessment of the value of the project land(s) with clear rationale explaining how the value was determined will be required.
1) Species at Risk observation table ✓ 2)Species at risk recovery table ✓ 3) Workplan outlining all activities and draft timelines
9) Fee simple only: Purchase and Sale Agreement / Option to Purchase / Signed Donation Agreement or Intent to Donate
